## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated reformatting.
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, or the reason is explained above.
- [ ] Permissions follow the existing viewer/member/admin/owner model.
- [ ] API, configuration or deployment changes are documented.
- [ ] The changelog has an `Unreleased` entry for user-visible changes.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, databases or uploaded images are included.
